title: Obsidian global settings
whyItMatters: Obsidian keeps global settings, window state and the list of vaults here. It shows the app was used and which vault folders were opened.
source: Obsidian Help, How Obsidian stores data: Linux global settings at $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/obsidian - https://obsidian.md/help/data-storage
notes: Global settings only. Vault notes and each vault's .obsidian folder live wherever the user chose and are not searched. The JSON files are never opened.

cleanup.exportFirst: Confirm every Obsidian vault you need is backed up or synced, because this cleanup does not touch the vault folders.
steps: Confirm every vault is backed up or synced.
If you decide to remove the app, uninstall Obsidian from your software manager or Flatpak.
Delete the Obsidian settings folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes global Obsidian settings and the recent-vault list. Notes and vault configuration folders are not touched.
cleanup.source: Obsidian Help, How Obsidian stores data: https://obsidian.md/help/data-storage
